context: Hina-young takes Yumiko to use a new pharmacy app; gentle teaching.
purpose: Teen helping grandparent navigate digital tools.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、このアプリ便利だよ。
lines.en: Grandma, this app is really handy.
lines.style: Bright and eager, speaking directly to her. Quick pace, helpful tone. Wants to be taken seriously as someone who knows useful things. Genuine warmth underneath the confidence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、どうやって使うの?
lines.style: Soft curiosity, leaning in. Not asking to be taught so much as to follow along with her granddaughter. Warm, genuinely interested. Open and attentive.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: First we register — I'll handle it.
lines.style: Take-charge but not bossy. Clear, capable delivery. Slight lift on the offer to help, like she's proud to be useful. Steady, confident pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう、頼もしいわ。
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. A moment of tenderness in the voice. Not rushed. The kind of praise a mother gives when she means it, letting the words land.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 通知、薬の時間に来るよ。
lines.en: Notifications will come at medicine time.
lines.style: Practical and gentle. Speaking as though explaining something important but not complicated. Even pace. Attentive to the purpose — making sure grandma understands it's meant to help her.
